PR: feat: ​add refreshPolicy field to ExternalSecret for enhanced synchronization control​ [closed]
## Problem Statement

The semantics of RefreshInterval is "RefreshInterval is the amount of time before the values ​​are read again from the SecretStore provider".

If RefreshInterval is 0, it means that the value will never be obtained from SecretStore.

In many scenarios, users do not want to delete the secret unless it is rebuilt, but want to use ExternalSecret to update the value in the corresponding secret. The current implementation does not support this, but I think this field sho…

auto refresh interval, which will improve the user experience. In addition to automatic updates, manual updates are also possible.

This PR implements this function: "Even if the user sets RefreshInterval to 0, he can also use the method of updating labels or Annotations to trigger another update."
